def maximumScore(nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    n = len(nums)
    upper = max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1
    prime = [True] * upper
    prime[0] = False
    prime[1] = False
    primeScore = [0] * upper
    
    i = 2
    while i < upper:
        if prime[i]:
            j = i
            while j < upper:
                primeScore[j] += 1
                j += i
            prime[i] = False
        i += 1
    
    nextGreaterElement = [n] * n
    s = []
    i = n - 1
    while i >= 0:
        while s and primeScore[nums[i]] >= primeScore[nums[s[-1]]]:
            nextGreaterElement[i] = s[-1]
            s.pop()
        s.append(i)
        i -= 1
    
    prevGreaterOrEqualElement = [-1] * n
    s = []
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        while s and primeScore[nums[i]] > primeScore[nums[s[-1]]]:
            prevGreaterOrEqualElement[i] = s[-1]
            s.pop()
        s.append(i)
        i += 1
    
    res = 1
    sorted_indices = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: nums[i], reverse=True)
    
    for i in sorted_indices:
        operations = min((i - prevGreaterOrEqualElement[i]) * (nextGreaterElement[i] - i), k)
        res = (res * pow(nums[i], operations, MOD)) % MOD
        k -= operations
        if k == 0:
            break
    
    return res
